result.keyword: What's the best help desk software for a small support team?
result.markdown:
For a small customer support team, I'd recommend **Freshdesk, Help Scout, or Zendesk**, depending on how you handle customer enquiries and how much automation you need.

My general recommendation is **Freshdesk**\: it offers a good balance of affordability, ticket management, automation and room to grow without the complexity of a large enterprise support platform.

Here are the platforms I'd shortlist.

## Best help desk software compared

![Top Free Customer Service Software in 2026 - Freshworks](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/5E2r2AcnIDT8zxLIiBADz7hJ8MoDzh_ulTvFG_8pkN5lnYNePkWR9wfYBeU0JTCyXfieSrXS13FyL6gvZXQBafGdl1pgWMvhtSXXYb4lkixcjz35s8nCMtgLbBtCtMUBB-S50yzPR2WJ7cFRTyIsXX65wwHU3s7ubgQYwXkEN4rZ-JrQ3s4HUtiKIs0TK67p?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Freshdesk**

(Best overall)

- Great ticket management and automation.
- Email, chat and social support.
- Knowledge base and reporting.
- Good scalability for a growing team.

Paid plans from approximately \$19/agent/month, annual billing.

[Freshdesk website](https://www.freshworks.com/freshdesk/)

Free plan for up to 3 agents; paid plans from approximately \$7/user/month.

| Complex support workflows | Zendesk |
